# v1.3.0 Release Notes — Minimal Mode Evolution, Mobile Polish & Cloud Session Stability

**`bot-team v1.3.0`** refines high-velocity daily supervision across Desktop, Cloud Web, iPadOS, and iOS PWA (`c2c3620..HEAD` in `bot-team` and `da54134..HEAD` in `bot-team-services`, **15 tracked engineering slices**). Feeds Minimal Mode evolves into an intelligent, zero-drift triage surface with **live handling-priority sorting** (`#F-527`), **flush borderless Mobile timelines** (`#F-525`, `#C-528-1`), **raw-body previews by default with opt-in AI titles** (`#F-521`), and **worker-focused attribution** (`#F-524`). On Mobile and iPad, a **Linear-iOS `NewIssueSheet` with 3D depth motion** (`#F-532`), **unified Workspace + Device header switcher** (`#F-529`), **iOS swipe-to-exit Feed details** (`#F-518`), and **sliding `6h` / `120s`-grace Cloud sessions with latched `authPhase` recovery** (`#F-530`, `#F-531`) make remote direction effortless — while keeping the 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` closure 100% untouched (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).


## Architecture Overview (`v1.3.0`)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Desktop["Desktop & iPad Shell (Priority Minimal Mode · Borderless Icon Toggles)"]
    Mobile["iOS PWA & Mobile Web (Flush Minimal Stream · 3D Issue Sheet · Latched authPhase)"]
    Edge["Railway Cloud Gateway (60m Access TTL · 6h Sliding Refresh · 120s Grace)"]
    Core["Tier-2 CoreServer (aiFeedMinimalTitle Gate · Feeds Priority & Worker Filtering)"]
    Helpers["HelperDaemon (Opt-In Fast Helper shortTitle Generation)"]
    Daemon["Tier-1 AgentDaemon (Frozen 20-File Runtime Closure)"]

    Desktop <-->|"Local IPC or Loopback CloudMux"| Core
    Mobile <-->|"Calm Reconnect HTTPS + SSE"| Edge
    Edge <-->|"Authenticated WSS Tunnel"| Core
    Core -->|"Gated on aiFeedMinimalTitle = true"| Helpers
    Core -->|"Resolved Prompts & Lifecycle"| Daemon
```


## 1. Priority-Sorted Feeds Minimal Mode, Zero-Drift Cards & Opt-In AI Titles (`#F-517`, `#F-519`, `#F-520`, `#F-521`, `#F-524`, `#F-527`)

Feeds Minimal Mode now surfaces active work first, eliminates visual clutter, and respects raw operator wording by default:

- **Live Handling-Priority Auto-Sort (`BOT-444`, `2237353`, `#F-527`)**: automatically orders Minimal Mode threads by live handling priority tier — placing active in-progress/needs-attention threads at the top above idle and resolved threads while maintaining deterministic chronological order within each tier (`cli/test/feeds-minimal-sort.mjs`).
- **Borderless Minimal Tags, Sidebar Agent Dots & `0px`-Drift Expand (`BOT-436`, `293cdf1`, `#F-517`, `#F-519`, `#F-520`)**: replaces boxed metadata pills with quiet borderless tags and sidebar-style status dots, clamps collapsed titles cleanly to 2 lines, and eliminates vertical layout jump when folding or expanding threads.
- **Worker-Focused Attribution (`BOT-442`, `b2b68ee`, `#F-524`)**: suppresses redundant orchestrator/leader badges (`bot-lead`, `bot-lead-sub-*`) on Minimal Mode cards whenever concrete specialist workers are already assigned (`cli/test/feed-minimal-agents.mjs`).
- **Body-First Previews & Default-Off `aiFeedMinimalTitle` (`BOT-440`, `BOT-441`, `5d5bf2f`, `b0c5e50`, `#F-521`)**: displays crisp raw post text by default in Minimal Mode and gates Fast Helper `shortTitle` generation behind an explicit **AI Minimal Mode Titles** toggle in Settings on Desktop and Mobile (`cli/test/feeds-short-title.mjs`).

![Priority-sorted Feeds Minimal Mode on Desktop surfacing active handling tiers first](./artifact/feeds-minimal-sort-desktop.png)

![Default raw-body Minimal Mode previews on Desktop when AI short titles are disabled](./artifact/desktop-feeds-minimal-body-default.png)

![Default-off AI Minimal Mode feed title setting in Desktop Settings](./artifact/desktop-settings-ai-minimal-title-off.png)


## 2. Borderless Twitter-Style Mobile Minimal Stream & Clean Chrome (`#F-522`, `#C-522-1`, `#F-525`, `#C-528-1`, `#F-536`)

Mobile Feeds Minimal Mode has been tailored specifically for narrow touch screens rather than shrinking desktop card boxes:

- **Flush Left-Aligned Mobile Minimal Stream (`BOT-443`, `ca2c920`, `#F-525`, `#C-528-1`)**: redesigns Mobile Minimal Mode into an edge-to-edge, left-aligned Twitter/X-style stream separated by crisp `1px` hairlines while preserving spacious card framing on Desktop.
- **Borderless Header Toggles & Clean Composer (`BOT-438`, `BOT-439`, `BOT-450`, `20332ab`, `2e1bd68`, `4dde390`, `#F-522`, `#F-536`)**: converts both the Feeds Minimal Mode toggle and the Issues `Feeds` toggle into quiet borderless icons and removes redundant horizontal divider lines inside the Mobile feed composer.

![Flush borderless Twitter-style Feeds Minimal Mode stream on Mobile](./artifact/feeds-minimal-borderless-stream-mobile.png)

![Inline thread expansion inside the borderless Mobile Minimal stream](./artifact/feeds-minimal-borderless-stream-mobile-expanded.png)

![Clean divider-free Mobile feed composer sheet](./artifact/mobile-feed-composer-clean.png)


## 3. Native iOS Sheet Craft: Linear-Style New Issue, Swipe-to-Exit & Unified Header (`#F-518`, `#F-529`, `#F-532`)

Creating issues, inspecting unified Feeds, and switching workspaces on iPhone and iPad now feel unmistakably native:

- **Linear-iOS `NewIssueSheet` with 3D Depth Motion (`BOT-449`, `903c21d`, `#F-532`)**: rebuilds Mobile issue creation with a clean title/description canvas, compact inline property pills (Assignee, Priority, Dependencies, Review), and subtle iOS 3D background-scale depth transitions.
- **Unified Workspace + Device Header Trigger (`BOT-445`, `4149741`, `#F-529`)**: merges the standalone Mobile/iPad header device pill directly into the Workspace trigger and switcher drawer so switching hosts and folders happens from a single calm control.
- **Consistent iOS Edge-Swipe-to-Exit on Unified Feed Details (`BOT-437`, `a4e9c10`, `#F-518`)**: wraps unified Feed detail views inside `IssuePageContainer` so Mobile operators can swipe back from the left screen edge seamlessly.

![Linear-iOS redesigned Mobile New Issue sheet with tactile 3D depth motion](./artifact/mobile-new-issue-linear-ios.png)

![Unified Workspace and Device header trigger on Mobile](./artifact/mobile-header-unified-workspace-device.png)

![Unified Workspace and Device sidebar header in iPad Landscape](./artifact/ipad-landscape-unified-workspace-device.png)

![iOS swipe-to-exit navigation on unified Feed detail inside Issues](./artifact/issues-feed-detail-ios-swipe.png)


## 4. Sliding-Refresh Cloud Sessions & Latched Mobile Web `authPhase` (`#F-530`, `#F-531`)

Mobile Web and iOS Home-Screen PWAs stay signed in across multi-hour standby and flaky cellular handoffs without flickering back to the login screen:

- **Cloud Gateway `60m` Access TTL, `6h` Sliding Refresh & `120s` Grace (`BOT-446`, `bot-team-services` `fdcbc56`, `#F-530`)**: extends access-token lifetime to `60m`, slides active refresh sessions forward by `6h` on rotation, widens concurrent-tab refresh grace to `120s` to absorb mobile wake storms, and revokes the entire token family cleanly on explicit logout (`security-cloud-wave1.mjs`, `cloud-e2e.mjs`).
- **Latched `authPhase` State Machine & Calm Offline Reconnect (`BOT-447`, `BOT-448`, `4ca7083`, `bot-team-services` `f4859c2`, `#F-530`)**: latches authenticated sessions across transient `5xx`/timeout/offline failures — showing a quiet reconnecting state instead of bouncing to `CloudAuthGate` until an authoritative `401` confirms session expiry (`cli/test/cloud-session-resilience.mjs`).

![Calm Mobile Web loading and offline reconnection without login-screen ping-pong](./artifact/mobile-web-calm-loading-and-offline-stability.png)

## Verification & Upgrade Notes

- **Full Pre-Release Verification Gate**: `sync-shared --check`, `@bot-team/cli build`, `daemon-boundary` (`10/10` — frozen Tier-1 closure untouched, `daemonOutdated === false`), `core-hot-reload` (`14/14`), `feeds-short-title`, `feed-minimal-agents`, `feeds-minimal-sort`, `cloud-session-resilience`, `@bot-team/app` renderer & Electron `tsc --noEmit`, Vite production bundle, and `pnpm lint:comments` (`0` comments) all verified 100% green prior to packaging `v1.3.0`.
- **Journal & Cover Art Compliance (`#F-391` · `#C-374-1` · `#F-199`)**: authored for `BOT-451` (`#F-537`) with verified `./artifact/` visuals across every shipped pillar and a flat Apple Newsroom `#F5F5F7` monochrome cover (`./artifact/bot-team-v130-release-cover.png`, solid `#F5F5F7` canvas, flat `#FFFFFF` cards with `1px` hairlines, zero neon, zero gradients, zero glowing halos, zero colored border stripes).
- **Clean Byte-Reproducible Release (`sourceDirty: false`) & In-Place Auto-Update**: packaged from a clean committed `bot-team` tree pushed to `origin/master`, synced live to Railway `cloud-gateway`, and published to `AgenticPunk/bot-team-release` (`v1.3.0`) with embedded `releaseNotes` in `latest.json` so `v1.2.0` Desktop clients can auto-update in place without interrupting running `AgentDaemon` turns.
